ddl.where: deleted_at is null and phone_number is not null
ddl.name: uq_farmers_phone_active

ddl.where: deleted_at is null and planned_crop_id is not null
ddl.name: idx_plots_planned_crop

ddl.value: boundary is not null or (centroid_lat is not null and centroid_lng is not null and radius_m > 0)
ddl.name: kebeles_territory_check

ddl.value: full_name = btrim(full_name) and char_length(full_name) between 2 and 120
ddl.name: farmers_full_name_check

ddl.value: not consent_agreed or consent_agreed_at is not null
ddl.name: farmers_consent_check

ddl.value: kind <> 'audio' or duration_s is null or duration_s::integer <= 180
ddl.name: media_files_duration_check

ddl.value:
(application_type = 'basal' and fertilizer_product in ('nps', 'nps_zinc'))
        or (application_type in ('urea_1', 'urea_2') and fertilizer_product = 'urea')
ddl.name: fertilizer_logs_product_check

ddl.value:
(applied and quantity_kg::numeric > 0 and quantity_kg::numeric <= 1000
           and application_date is not null
           and skip_reason is null)
        or
        (not applied and skip_reason is not null
           and quantity_kg is null and application_date is null)
ddl.name: fertilizer_logs_applied_check

ddl.value:
not applied
        or application_type = 'basal'
        or growth_stage_at_application is not null
ddl.name: fertilizer_logs_growth_stage_check

ddl.value:
(operation_type = 'plowing' and sequence_no::integer between 1 and 10)
        or (operation_type = 'weeding' and sequence_no::integer between 1 and 6)
        or (operation_type = 'spraying'
            and chemical_id is not null and product_rate::numeric > 0 and rate_unit is not null)
        or (operation_type = 'irrigation'
            and irrigation_method is not null and duration_minutes::integer between 1 and 1440)
ddl.name: field_operations_type_check

ddl.value: seed_variety_id is not null or seed_variety_other is not null
ddl.name: sowing_logs_variety_check

ddl.value: confidence is null or (confidence::numeric >= 0 and confidence::numeric <= 1)
ddl.name: diagnosis_cases_confidence_check

ddl.value:
(message_type = 'text' and text_body is not null)
        or (message_type = 'audio' and audio_media_id is not null)
ddl.name: grievance_messages_content_check

ddl.value: audio_media_id is not null or text_note is not null
ddl.name: grievances_content_check

ddl.value: status not in ('assigned', 'in_progress') or assignee_user_id is not null
ddl.name: grievances_assignee_check

ddl.value: resolved_at is null or received_at is null or resolved_at >= received_at
ddl.name: grievances_resolved_check

ddl.value: moderation_status <> 'rejected' or rejection_reason is not null
ddl.name: crowd_transactions_rejection_check

ddl.value:
min_price_etb_per_kg::numeric > 0
        and min_price_etb_per_kg::numeric <= avg_price_etb_per_kg::numeric
        and avg_price_etb_per_kg::numeric <= max_price_etb_per_kg::numeric
ddl.name: market_surveys_prices_check

ddl.value: status <> 'verified' or verified_at is not null
ddl.name: market_surveys_verified_check

ddl.value: item_type <> 'seed' or crop_id is not null
ddl.name: depot_stock_items_seed_crop_check

ddl.value:
(movement_type = 'receipt' and quantity_delta::numeric > 0)
        or (movement_type = 'issue' and quantity_delta::numeric < 0)
        or (movement_type = 'adjustment' and quantity_delta::numeric <> 0)
ddl.name: depot_stock_movements_quantity_check

ddl.value: status <> 'published' or published_at is not null
ddl.name: announcements_published_check
